Strand: Foundations of Creative Arts and Sports
Topic 1.2: Components of Creative Arts and Sports
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Components of Creative Arts and Sports, part of Foundations of Creative Arts and Sports in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: How are the components of Creative Arts and Sports inter- related? 2. How are components of Creative Arts and Sports applied?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. describe elements of a story,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Components of Creative Arts and Sports in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. perform activities demonstrating the components of fitness,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Components of Creative Arts and Sports in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. write note values on a treble staff,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Components of Creative Arts and Sports in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Components of Creative Arts and Sports together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication: the learner develops effective verbal expression and written communication skills while discussing the

elements of storytelling.

● Collaboration: the learner embraces teamwork and mutual support while singing familiar tunes.

● Digital Literacy: the learner interacts with digital devices while watching virtual activities of fitness and watching videos

to appreciate how the components of Creative Arts and Sports relate to each other.

● Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: the learner applies critical thinking to demonstrate fitness exercises from the

observations made related to personal fitness.
